description: This Java source file defines the RomCellRenderer class, which implements the TreeCellRenderer interface for customizing the appearance of tree nodes in a Swing JTree component. The class renders tree nodes that represent ROM files and table nodes with specific icons and styles based on the data type and properties.

classes.name: RomCellRenderer
classes.description: A custom tree cell renderer for displaying ROM files and table nodes with specific icons and styles in a Swing JTree.
